Container.Name: iSponsorBlockTV-Web
Container.Overview: Unofficial iSponsorBlockTV fork with a password-protected WebGUI. Manage devices, pair Google Cast receivers, adjust SponsorBlock and ad-muting settings, and view service logs. Includes night mode and configuration backups. Mutes YouTube ads and requests skips when available; it does not remove every advertisement. Set a password of at least 12 characters before starting. Stop any previous iSponsorBlockTV instance before reusing its data directory.
Container.Requires: A password of at least 12 characters. Network access to YouTube and supported receivers. Cross-VLAN discovery may require direct-IP pairing and appropriate firewall rules.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent configuration and backups. Reuse your existing iSponsorBlockTV data directory only after stopping the previous container.

Config.Name: WebGUI password
Config.Description: Required: choose a password of at least 12 characters. Hidden while typing; stored as a Docker environment variable.

Config.Name: WebGUI port
Config.Description: Listening port on the host. If changed, also update the WebUI URL in Advanced View.

Config.Name: Allowed receiver networks
Config.Description: Comma-separated private IPv4 CIDRs containing your receivers. Restricts device checks; does not bypass firewall rules or control browser access.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Set your local timezone, for example America/Chicago or Europe/London.
